name: 31904 · Columbus, GA
findings: ZIP 31904 (Columbus) has 139 nonprofit organizations. 50 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 34 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 31904 (Columbus) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
